items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: Cyril Vedder? No, not Cyril. The other guy.

ctx.x: Actually, the band really wrote that song. And what's his name? He went on to write some real hits.

I'm supposed to think I had the band. It was Jimmy's band? Jimmy's band? No, it was the band Jimmy was with. The label credit is Jimmy Clanton and his Rockets. Yeah, well, it was the Rockets. It wasn't. Well, he got credit for it. The Rockets. What's his name? He wrote Double Shot of My Baby's Love. Cyril Vedder? No, not Cyril. The other guy. It was his band. Jimmy was a singer with the band. Right.
Okay. And I took a management contract on him. We started having some successes and stuff. And it went from. Jimmy Clanton and.
